description: Tasks whose konductor rules require a reviewer spawn, for the report's Review compliance section (report/delegation.js). Sources: the konductor agent prompt, Verification Protocol item 2 (no reviewer for a lookup or a small passing one-file change, unless it touches auth, secrets, data, or infrastructure), and the delegation protocol's phase gate (a threat model goes to k-architect with threat-modeling). A task matches a rule when one of its targetSkills is in the rule's targetSkills or its id is in the rule's taskIds. A run complied when it made at least one reviewer spawn (makerSpawns and reviewerSpawns in report/orch.js). Tasks where the agent is itself the reviewer (code and design review tasks) are not listed: they produce a review, not a change.

rules.why: a threat model is a security design; the phase gate sends it to a reviewer
an IAM policy, a secrets fix or a security remediation touches auth, secrets or infrastructure (Verification Protocol item 2)
webhook signature checking is an auth change (Verification Protocol item 2)
